sources.note: Developer website now redirects to main Ensora Health page; EchoVantage product page appears to have been folded into the broader Ensora site. Shows TheraNest and Fusion as primary products; EchoVantage no longer prominently featured.
ONC mandatory disclosures page for EchoVantage Version 3. Confirms single-patient and population EHI export, FHIR API compliance, MFA as add-on. Located in Birmingham, AL.
Former EchoVantage capabilities page (now redirects to ensorahealth.com). Historically described Visual EHR, billing, scheduling, state reporting, and clinical intelligence engine.

Product overview describing EchoVantage as integrated behavioral health EHR with scheduling, billing, clinical workflow, ePrescribing, telehealth, reporting, lab integration, and voice recognition. Lists target users including solo/group practices, community health centers, correctional facilities.

Product profile listing billing/RCM, e-prescribing via DrFirst, business intelligence dashboards (30+ presets), client engagement features, telehealth. Serves I/DD, mental health, substance abuse organizations.

Review site with approximately 10-15 user reviews. Users note customizability and behavioral health focus as strengths. Complaints about development team missing basic EHR functionality and weak financial module compared to competitors.
Shows 86% user satisfaction rating based on 15 reviews. Scores 64/100 overall in EMR category. Notes falling user trend.

November 2022 acquisition announcement. Echo Group founded ~1981, privately held, HQ in Conway NH. Partners range from small community behavioral health agencies to enterprise organizations. No specific customer counts disclosed.
Third-party coverage of Therapy Brands acquisition of The Echo Group. Describes Echo Group as providing EHR specific to behavioral health agency needs since 1981.
Early 2025 announcement of Therapy Brands rebranding to Ensora Health. Unified platform for mental, behavioral, and rehabilitative therapy.

Press release detailing EchoVantage roadmap: MAT module for Methadone dosing (H1 2025), AI billing tools, new forms designer, clinical intelligence engine, MedlinePlus integration, Apex Clearinghouse integration. Notes Ensora serves 30,000+ therapy practices across portfolio.

Partnership with Eleos Health for AI-powered session documentation. Voice-based NLU converts therapy conversations into notes. Reduces documentation time 30%+. Provides supervisor visibility into staff activity and caseloads.
Original EchoVantage launch announcement describing Visual Health Record (VHR), clinical intelligence engine, and billing workflow visualization.
